nodes.label:
Candidate
Interviewed
nodes.title: Mentor Interview Process
nodes.info: A short structured set of questions -- the same five or six for every candidate -- scored against a simple rubric, so two different people interviewing two candidates reach comparable judgements.

nodes.label: Trial Session
nodes.title: Trial Session (Chapter 34)
nodes.info: A one-session hands-on trial checking technical comfort and patience with students, introduced in Chapter 34.

nodes.label:
Training
Curriculum
nodes.title: Mentor Training Curriculum
nodes.info: The fixed sequence of topics every new mentor works through before running any part of a session unsupervised: electrical safety, the specific kits they will support, and the club's own norms.

nodes.label:
Matched to
Strengths
nodes.title: Bringing Out Mentor Strengths
nodes.info: Deliberately matching each mentor's individual talents to the role where those talents matter most, instead of rotating everyone through identical duties.

nodes.label:
Certification
Tier?
nodes.title: Mentor Certification Program
nodes.info: Every mentor holds a named tier -- Trainee, Certified, or Lead Mentor -- based on specific checkable criteria. Each tier unlocks a specific new responsibility rather than serving as a badge.

nodes.label: Trainee
nodes.title: Trainee
nodes.info: Works alongside a certified mentor at all times. The tier exists so that 'new' is a defined state with defined limits, not an informal impression.

nodes.label: Certified
nodes.title: Certified
nodes.info: Runs a station unsupervised and supports students directly. The tier most mentors stay at, and the club runs on it.

nodes.label: Lead Mentor
nodes.title: Lead Mentor
nodes.info: Runs a whole session and supervises other mentors. This is the tier the leadership pipeline draws from.

nodes.label:
Peer Support
Program
nodes.title: Mentor Peer Support Program
nodes.info: Pairing a newer mentor with a veteran for regular check-ins, plus a standing mentor-only debrief. It runs continuously alongside every tier rather than at one stage.

nodes.label:
Leadership
Pipeline
nodes.title: Leadership Pipeline Development
nodes.info: Which certified mentors show early signs of being able to run the entire club, and how the club hands them incrementally larger responsibility long before any actual departure.

nodes.label:
Ready to Co-Lead or
Succeed the Founder
nodes.title: Ready to Co-Lead or Succeed the Founder
nodes.info: The mentor has practised real decisions well before any departure forces the issue, which is the only version of succession planning that works.
